title: Tilting realizations of derived-equivalent matrix centralizer algebras
summary: Let $A$ be the centralizer algebra of a matrix over an arbitrary field. We solve the fixed-source realization problem for matrix centralizers by proving that the matrix centralizer algebras derived equivalent to $A$ are precisely the opposite endomorphism algebras of tilting modules over $A$. We classify the basic tilting modules and determine their opposite endomorphism algebras. The tilting poset is a product of right weak orders on symmetric groups, with one factor for each primary block and degree equal to the number of distinct exponents in that block.
